hook: [act:hushed, drawing us in]The end of the last Ice Age was a ^wild ride. [act:wonder, widening out]Sudden cold, giant floods, a comet swarm, vanishing ^giants. [act:the big question][tune:rise]Did the ^sky fall? [act:bright, rolling up sleeves][tune:fall]Let's investigate ^six clues, one by ^one.

cases.where: the end of the last Ice Age
cases.t1: [act:storytelling, like a guide]First stop: the end of the Ice ^Age, about twelve thousand nine hundred years ago, when the cold snapped ^back.
cases.t3: [act:explaining]Draw the temperature: up, a sharp ^dip, then up again. [p:0.9][act:the leading idea, the analogy]The likeliest suspect@noun is ^meltwater, stalling the ocean like a jammed ^conveyor belt.

cases.t1: [act:storytelling]Next, eastern ^Washington: a dry waterfall so wide, ^Niagara would fit inside seven ^times.
cases.t2: [act:the old debate][tune:rise]Carved by a giant ^flood, in days, as J Harlen ^Bretz said in {1923|nineteen twenty-three}?
cases.t3: [act:the analogy]An Ice Age lake, dammed by ^ice, emptied like a bath with the plug ^pulled, about forty ^times.

cases.t1: [act:storytelling]Next, look ^up. [act:painting the picture]Twice a year, Earth flies through the ^wreckage of comet ^Encke.
cases.t2: [act:the challenger, fair][tune:rise]Leftovers of a ^giant comet, the one that ended the Ice Age ^world?
cases.t3: [act:the analogy]A giant would leave ^hundreds of big pieces, like a smashed ^plate. [act:landing it]Astronomers counted: only about nine to ^fourteen.

cases.t2: [act:the challenger, fair][tune:rise]Killed by one blow from the ^sky?
cases.t3: [act:explaining]By the dates: Australia's giants went forty-six thousand years ago, and mammoths on an Arctic island lasted until about four ^thousand. [act:the analogy]Like guests leaving a party one by ^one.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict, firm][tune:fall]One cataclysm: *ruled ^out* by the dates. [act:even][tune:fall]Hunting, climate, or both: still ^argued.

cases.t1: [act:storytelling]Next, America's east ^coast: half a million ^ovals, all pointing the ^same way.
cases.t2: [act:the challenger, fair][tune:rise]Craters from one comet, all at ^once?
cases.t3: [p:0.9][act:the analogy]Buried sand is a ^stopwatch that starts when sunlight last touches it. [act:landing it]The rims: a hundred and nine ^thousand years old, down to two thousand.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict, firm][tune:fall]One blast: *ruled ^out* by the dates. [act:warm][tune:fall]Wind@air and ^waves, over ages.

cases.evidence_note: the black mat: c. 12,900 years ago
cases.t1: [act:storytelling]Last stop: a dark layer, the ^black mat, lying on the last mammoth ^bones.
cases.t2: [act:the challenger, fair][tune:rise]Some teams report ^impact markers here: a ^comet?
cases.t3: [p:0.9][act:the analogy]The fair test: ^blind re-sampling, where labs don't know which layer is which, like a blind taste ^test. [act:plain]No crater of the right age has turned ^up.

close: [act:stepping back, calm]So, what do our six clues say ^together?
[act:clear, warm]The cold, the floods, the comet swarm, the vanishing ^giants: all ^real.
[act:fair, precise]But each time a single ^blast was put to the test, the dates spread things out over ^ages.
[act:warm, curious][tune:fall]Something abrupt ^did happen; we just haven't caught ^what.
